name: Walmart

business_roles.scope_note: A mass retailer positioned on low prices, with groceries as its largest category in the United States. Research the US stores, the international business and the warehouse clubs separately.

observables_to_research: comparable sales split into transactions and average ticket
the mix of grocery against general merchandise
comments on which income groups are gaining or losing share of its shoppers

exposures.mechanism_hypothesis: It imports general merchandise itself as well as buying from suppliers, so a tariff reaches its cost of goods directly on those items and through suppliers' prices on the rest.
Its international stores earn in local currencies, so the dollar's moves change the reported size of that business without changing its trade.

edge_conditions.lead:consumer_products:household_demand:: For Walmart the hypothesis is the gaining side: test whether it states a gain in share of US grocery and everyday goods when real incomes fall. A stated loss of share in such a period counts against it. Its transactions and its comments on shoppers from higher income groups are context.
